class _BundleImporter(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder, importlib.abc.SourceLoader):
    """Load actual package modules and resources directly from the embedded ZIP."""
    def __init__(self):
        self.archive = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(base64.b85decode(_PAYLOAD)))
        self.root = os.path.abspath(__file__) + "/__bundle__/"
        self.names = set(self.archive.namelist())

    def _name(self, fullname):
        path = fullname.replace(".", "/")
        return path + "/__init__.py" if path + "/__init__.py" in self.names else path + ".py"

    def find_spec(self, fullname, path=None, target=None):
        if fullname != "tesla_sentry" and not fullname.startswith("tesla_sentry."):
            return None
        name = self._name(fullname)
        if name not in self.names:
            return None
        return importlib.util.spec_from_loader(fullname, self, is_package=name.endswith("/__init__.py"))

    def get_filename(self, fullname):
        return self.root + self._name(fullname)

    def get_data(self, path):
        name = path[len(self.root):] if path.startswith(self.root) else path
        try:
            return self.archive.read(name)
        except KeyError:
            raise FileNotFoundError(path) from None

    def get_code(self, fullname):
        filename = self.get_filename(fullname)
        return compile(self.get_data(filename), filename, "exec", dont_inherit=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.meta_path.insert(0, _BundleImporter())
    try:
        from tesla_sentry.cli import main
        raise SystemExit(main(entrypoint=ENTRYPOINT))
    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
        print("Configuration error: %s" % error, file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(2)

#!/bin/sh
# tesla-gadget.sh - 把镜像文件导出为 USB 虚拟U盘 (mass_storage)
# 用法: tesla-gadget.sh on|off|status|restore
#
# 设计要点:
#  - 只在现有 gadget 里"追加" mass_storage 功能, 不动 ncm/acm, 所以 USB 网卡和串口不中断
#  - 绑定失败自动回滚, 避免设备从 USB 上消失
#  - 所有设备路径自动探测, 不写死

set -a
[ ! -f "${TSF_CONF:-/etc/tesla-sentry.conf}" ] || . "${TSF_CONF:-/etc/tesla-sentry.conf}"
set +a

if [ -z "${TSF_USB_LOCK_FD:-}" ]; then
    SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
    VIEWER="${TSF_DIR:-/opt/tesla-sentry}/sentry-viewer.py"
    [ -f "$VIEWER" ] || VIEWER="$SCRIPT_DIR/../sentry-viewer.py"
    exec "${TSF_PYTHON:-python3}" "$VIEWER" --usb-lock-exec /bin/sh "$0" "$@"
fi


: "${TSF_DIR:=/opt/tesla-sentry}"
: "${TSF_IMG:=$TSF_DIR/teslacam.img}"
: "${TSF_LOG_DIR:=$TSF_DIR}"
IMG="$TSF_IMG"
LOG="$TSF_LOG_DIR/tesla-gadget.log"
CONF_NAME="${TSF_GADGET_CONFIG:-c.1}"

log() { echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*" >> "$LOG"; }

# --- 自动探测 ---
find_gadget() {
    if [ -n "$TSF_GADGET" ] && [ -d "$TSF_GADGET" ]; then echo "$TSF_GADGET"; return 0; fi
    for d in /sys/kernel/config/usb_gadget/*/; do
        [ -d "$d/configs" ] && { echo "${d%/}"; return 0; }
    done
    return 1
}

GADGET=$(find_gadget) || { echo "ERROR: 找不到 USB gadget (configfs 未挂载?)"; exit 1; }
UDC=$(ls /sys/class/udc/ 2>/dev/null | head -1)
[ -z "$UDC" ] && { echo "ERROR: 没有 USB Device 控制器 (UDC)"; exit 1; }

# configfs 里的配置名可能不叫 c.1
[ -d "$GADGET/configs/$CONF_NAME" ] || CONF_NAME=$(ls "$GADGET/configs" 2>/dev/null | head -1)

FUNC_DIR="$GADGET/functions/mass_storage.0"
LINK="$GADGET/configs/$CONF_NAME/massstorage"

state() { cat "/sys/class/udc/$UDC/state" 2>/dev/null; }
bind()   { echo "$UDC" > "$GADGET/UDC"; }
unbind() { echo "" > "$GADGET/UDC"; }

status() {
    echo "gadget : $GADGET (config=$CONF_NAME)"
    echo "udc    : $UDC  state=$(state)"
    echo "lun    : $(cat "$FUNC_DIR/lun.0/file" 2>/dev/null || echo '未挂载')"
    echo "image  : $IMG ($(du -sh "$IMG" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1) 实际占用)"
    echo "--- gadget 功能 ---"
    ls "$GADGET/configs/$CONF_NAME/" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^max_speed$'
}

do_on() {
    grep -qs " ${TSF_MNT:-/tmp/teslamnt} " /proc/mounts && { echo "BUSY: image mounted"; exit 75; }
    [ -f "$IMG" ] || { echo "ERROR: 镜像不存在: $IMG"; exit 1; }
    if [ -e "$FUNC_DIR" ] && [ "$(cat "$FUNC_DIR/lun.0/file" 2>/dev/null)" = "$IMG" ]; then
        echo "ALREADY-ON"; exit 0
    fi
    log "=== ON: exporting $IMG ==="
    unbind; sleep 1

    mkdir -p "$FUNC_DIR"
    echo 1 > "$FUNC_DIR/lun.0/removable"
    echo "$IMG" > "$FUNC_DIR/lun.0/file"
    # 链接已存在(含悬空链接)时不要再 ln, configfs 下会报 Operation not permitted
    if [ ! -L "$LINK" ] && [ ! -e "$LINK" ]; then ln -sf "$FUNC_DIR" "$LINK"; fi

    bind; sleep 3
    st=$(state)
    log "state after bind: $st"
    if [ "$st" != "configured" ] && [ "$st" != "addressed" ]; then
        log "BIND FAILED, rolling back"
        unbind 2>/dev/null
        rm -f "$LINK" 2>/dev/null
        rmdir "$FUNC_DIR" 2>/dev/null
        sleep 1
        bind; sleep 2
        echo "ERROR: 绑定失败已回滚, state=$(state)"; exit 1
    fi
    echo "TESLA-GADGET-ON (state=$st)"
}

do_off() {
    log "=== OFF: removing mass_storage ==="
    unbind; sleep 1
    rm -f "$LINK" 2>/dev/null
    rmdir "$FUNC_DIR" 2>/dev/null
    bind; sleep 2
    log "state: $(state)"
    echo "TESLA-GADGET-OFF (state=$(state))"
}

# 只重新绑定 UDC (镜像管理模式结束后用)
do_restore() {
    grep -qs " ${TSF_MNT:-/tmp/teslamnt} " /proc/mounts && exit 75
    bind; sleep 2
    log "restore bind, state=$(state)"
    echo "RESTORED (state=$(state))"
}

case "$1" in
    on)      do_on ;;
    off)     do_off ;;
    restore) do_restore ;;
    status)  status ;;
    *) echo "用法: $0 on|off|restore|status"; exit 2 ;;
esac

#!/bin/sh
# tesla-img.sh - 在「虚拟U盘镜像」上安全地执行操作
#
# 用法:
#   tesla-img.sh exec '<shell 命令>'   断开主机 -> 挂载镜像 -> 执行 -> 卸载 -> 重新挂回
#   tesla-img.sh detach                仅断开 LUN（电脑侧相当于弹出）
#   tesla-img.sh attach                仅挂回 LUN
#
# 为什么需要它:
#   镜像被 mass_storage 导出给主机（电脑/车机）时，设备侧同时写同一个文件，
#   主机的 FAT / 目录缓存不会刷新，会出现「新文件看不见」「可用空间不变」，
#   严重时目录项互相覆盖。任何设备侧写操作都必须先 detach。
#
# 可用环境变量覆盖: TSF_IMG / TSF_GADGET / TSF_LOOP / TSF_MNT

set -a
[ ! -f "${TSF_CONF:-/etc/tesla-sentry.conf}" ] || . "${TSF_CONF:-/etc/tesla-sentry.conf}"
set +a

if [ -z "${TSF_USB_LOCK_FD:-}" ]; then
    SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
    VIEWER="${TSF_DIR:-/opt/tesla-sentry}/sentry-viewer.py"
    [ -f "$VIEWER" ] || VIEWER="$SCRIPT_DIR/../sentry-viewer.py"
    exec "${TSF_PYTHON:-python3}" "$VIEWER" --usb-lock-exec /bin/sh "$0" "$@"
fi

BB=/opt/mu300/busybox-bin
LOSETUP=$BB/losetup
[ -x "$LOSETUP" ] || LOSETUP=losetup

find_gadget() {
    for d in /sys/kernel/config/usb_gadget/*/; do
        [ -e "$d/UDC" ] && { echo "${d%/}"; return 0; }
    done
    return 1
}

GADGET="${TSF_GADGET:-$(find_gadget)}"
[ -n "$GADGET" ] || { echo "ERROR: 找不到 USB gadget (configfs 未挂载?)"; exit 1; }

LUN="$GADGET/functions/mass_storage.0/lun.0"
[ -d "$LUN" ] || { echo "ERROR: 找不到 mass_storage LUN"; exit 1; }

IMG="${TSF_IMG:-$(cat "$LUN/file" 2>/dev/null)}"
[ -n "$IMG" ] || IMG=/root/teslacam.img
[ -f "$IMG" ] || { echo "ERROR: 镜像不存在: $IMG"; exit 1; }

LOOP="${TSF_LOOP:-/dev/loop3}"
MNT="${TSF_MNT:-/tmp/teslamnt}"

detach() { echo '' > "$LUN/file" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; }
attach() { echo "$IMG" > "$LUN/file" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; }

grep -qs " $MNT " /proc/mounts && { echo "BUSY: image mounted"; exit 75; }

case "$1" in
detach)
    detach
    echo "DETACHED"
    ;;
attach)
    attach
    echo "ATTACHED"
    ;;
exec)
    [ -z "$2" ] && { echo "usage: $0 exec '<cmd>'"; exit 1; }
    cleanup() {
        rc=$?
        trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
        if grep -qs " $MNT " /proc/mounts; then
            sync
            if ! umount "$MNT" 2>/dev/null; then
                echo "UNMOUNT-FAILED: export stays detached"
                exit 1
            fi
        fi
        $LOSETUP -d "$LOOP" 2>/dev/null
        attach || rc=1
        exit "$rc"
    }
    trap cleanup EXIT
    trap 'exit 1' HUP INT TERM
    detach || exit 1
    mkdir -p "$MNT"
    $LOSETUP "$LOOP" "$IMG" 2>/dev/null || exit 1
    if ! mount -t exfat -o rw "$LOOP" "$MNT" 2>/dev/null; then
        if ! mount -t vfat -o rw "$LOOP" "$MNT" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "MOUNT-FAILED"
            exit 1
        fi
    fi
    sh -c "$2"
    RC=$?
    echo "DONE rc=$RC"
    exit $RC
    ;;
*)
    echo "usage: $0 exec '<cmd>' | detach | attach"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

class _BundleImporter(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder, importlib.abc.SourceLoader):
    """Load actual package modules and resources directly from the embedded ZIP."""
    def __init__(self):
        self.archive = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(base64.b85decode(_PAYLOAD)))
        self.root = os.path.abspath(__file__) + "/__bundle__/"
        self.names = set(self.archive.namelist())

    def _name(self, fullname):
        path = fullname.replace(".", "/")
        return path + "/__init__.py" if path + "/__init__.py" in self.names else path + ".py"

    def find_spec(self, fullname, path=None, target=None):
        if fullname != "tesla_sentry" and not fullname.startswith("tesla_sentry."):
            return None
        name = self._name(fullname)
        if name not in self.names:
            return None
        return importlib.util.spec_from_loader(fullname, self, is_package=name.endswith("/__init__.py"))

    def get_filename(self, fullname):
        return self.root + self._name(fullname)

    def get_data(self, path):
        name = path[len(self.root):] if path.startswith(self.root) else path
        try:
            return self.archive.read(name)
        except KeyError:
            raise FileNotFoundError(path) from None

    def get_code(self, fullname):
        filename = self.get_filename(fullname)
        return compile(self.get_data(filename), filename, "exec", dont_inherit=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.meta_path.insert(0, _BundleImporter())
    try:
        from tesla_sentry.cli import main
        raise SystemExit(main(entrypoint=ENTRYPOINT))
    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
        print("Configuration error: %s" % error, file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(2)

tesla-sync.sh.content:
#!/bin/sh
# tesla-sync.sh - 归档哨兵视频 + 把锁车音/音效写入车机U盘
#
# 安全机制:
#  1. 镜像超过 TSF_IDLE 秒无写入才动手 (避免打断行车录制)
#  2. 归档期间虚拟U盘短暂消失(几秒), 结束后立即恢复导出
#  3. 网页处于"U盘管理"模式(镜像已被挂载)时自动跳过, 不抢 loop/UDC
#  4. 全程日志

set -a
[ ! -f "${TSF_CONF:-/etc/tesla-sentry.conf}" ] || . "${TSF_CONF:-/etc/tesla-sentry.conf}"
set +a

if [ -z "${TSF_USB_LOCK_FD:-}" ]; then
    SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
    VIEWER="${TSF_DIR:-/opt/tesla-sentry}/sentry-viewer.py"
    [ -f "$VIEWER" ] || VIEWER="$SCRIPT_DIR/../sentry-viewer.py"
    exec "${TSF_PYTHON:-python3}" "$VIEWER" --usb-lock-exec /bin/sh "$0" "$@"
fi


: "${TSF_DIR:=/opt/tesla-sentry}"
: "${TSF_IMG:=$TSF_DIR/teslacam.img}"
: "${TSF_ARCHIVE:=/archive}"
: "${TSF_MNT:=/tmp/teslamnt}"
: "${TSF_IDLE:=600}"
: "${TSF_LOG_DIR:=$TSF_DIR}"

IMG="$TSF_IMG"
ARCHIVE="$TSF_ARCHIVE"
AUDIO_Q="$ARCHIVE/boombox-queue"
AUDIO_DONE="$ARCHIVE/boombox-done"
MNT="$TSF_MNT"
IDLE="$TSF_IDLE"
LOG="$TSF_LOG_DIR/tesla-sync.log"

# --- 自动探测 ---
find_gadget() {
    if [ -n "$TSF_GADGET" ] && [ -d "$TSF_GADGET" ]; then echo "$TSF_GADGET"; return 0; fi
    for d in /sys/kernel/config/usb_gadget/*/; do
        [ -d "$d/configs" ] && { echo "${d%/}"; return 0; }
    done
    return 1
}
GADGET=$(find_gadget) || { echo "ERROR: gadget not found"; exit 1; }
UDC=$(ls /sys/class/udc/ 2>/dev/null | head -1)

# losetup: 优先系统自带, 兼容 busybox 精简系统
if [ -n "$TSF_LOSETUP" ]; then BB="$TSF_LOSETUP"
elif command -v losetup >/dev/null 2>&1; then BB=$(command -v losetup)
elif [ -x /opt/mu300/busybox-bin/losetup ]; then BB=/opt/mu300/busybox-bin/losetup
else BB="busybox losetup"; fi

log() { echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*" >> "$LOG"; }
restore() {
    [ -n "$UDC" ] || return 0
    echo "$UDC" > "$GADGET/UDC"
    log "export restored"
}
LB=""
DETACHED=0
cleanup() {
    rc=$?
    trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
    if [ "$DETACHED" = 1 ]; then
        if grep -qs " $MNT " /proc/mounts; then
            sync
            if ! umount "$MNT" 2>>"$LOG"; then
                log "ERROR: umount failed; USB export stays detached"
                exit 1
            fi
        fi
        [ -z "$LB" ] || $BB -d "$LB" 2>/dev/null
        restore || rc=1
    fi
    exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 1' HUP INT TERM

# 0. 网页 U 盘管理模式占用中则跳过
if grep -qs " $MNT " /proc/mounts; then
    log "skip: mirror mounted by viewer usb-manage"
    echo "SKIP-MANAGED"
    exit 0
fi

# 1. 空闲检测 (设备可能没有 stat, 用 ls --full-time 换算)
now=$(date +%s)
lsdate=$(ls -l --full-time "$IMG" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $6, $7}')
mtime=$(date -d "$lsdate" +%s 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "$mtime" ]; then
    log "WARN: cannot parse mtime ($lsdate), skip"
    echo "SKIP-MTIME"
    exit 0
fi
age=$((now - mtime))
if [ "$age" -lt "$IDLE" ]; then
    echo "busy (last write ${age}s ago), skip"
    exit 0
fi

log "=== sync start (idle ${age}s) ==="

# 2. 短暂停止导出
echo "" > "$GADGET/UDC" || exit 1
DETACHED=1
sleep 1

# 3. 显式 losetup + 读写挂载 (归档要读, 音频要写)
mkdir -p "$MNT" "$AUDIO_Q" "$AUDIO_DONE"
LB=$($BB -f 2>/dev/null)
[ -z "$LB" ] && LB=/dev/loop3
if ! $BB "$LB" "$IMG" 2>>"$LOG"; then
    log "ERROR: losetup $LB failed"
    exit 1
fi
if ! mount -t exfat "$LB" "$MNT" 2>>"$LOG"; then
    log "ERROR: mount image failed (镜像不是 exFAT?)"
    $BB -d "$LB" 2>/dev/null
    exit 1
fi

# 4. 与在线同步共用墓碑/滚动窗口策略, 合并部分归档的目录
copied=$("${TSF_PYTHON:-python3}" "$TSF_DIR/sentry-viewer.py" --archive-copy "$MNT") || exit 1
log "archived $copied new files"

# 5. 把待写入的音频直接写进车机U盘根目录
#    (上传的音频全部放根目录: LockChime.wav 即锁车音, 其它文件名原样放根目录)
pushed=0
has_audio=0
for f in "$AUDIO_Q"/*.wav "$AUDIO_Q"/*.mp3; do
    [ -f "$f" ] && has_audio=1 && break
done
if [ "$has_audio" = "1" ]; then
    for f in "$AUDIO_Q"/*.wav "$AUDIO_Q"/*.mp3; do
        [ -f "$f" ] || continue
        bn=$(basename "$f")
        dest="$MNT/$bn"
        if cp "$f" "$dest" 2>>"$LOG"; then
            mv "$f" "$AUDIO_DONE/" && pushed=$((pushed+1))
            log "audio -> ${dest#$MNT/}"
        else
            log "audio copy fail: $bn"
        fi
    done
    sync
    log "pushed $pushed audio -> USB root"
fi

# cleanup trap 卸载成功后才恢复导出
echo "SYNC-DONE copied=$copied audio=$pushed"

tsf-check.sh.content:
#!/bin/sh
# tsf-check.sh - 部署前自检: 判断这台设备能不能跑 Tesla Sentry F50
# 用法: sh tsf-check.sh            # 在本机执行 (最好 root)
#      sh tsf-check.sh --json      # 机器可读输出
#
# 检查的是"硬门槛"(缺了完全跑不起来) 与"软能力"(缺了只是功能降级), 最后给结论。

JSON=0
[ "$1" = "--json" ] && JSON=1

FAIL=0; WARN=0
ok()   { [ "$JSON" = "1" ] && echo "{\"item\":\"$1\",\"level\":\"ok\",\"detail\":\"$2\"}" || printf '  \033[32m✓\033[0m %-22s %s\n' "$1" "$2"; }
warn() { WARN=$((WARN+1)); [ "$JSON" = "1" ] && echo "{\"item\":\"$1\",\"level\":\"warn\",\"detail\":\"$2\"}" || printf '  \033[33m!\033[0m %-22s %s\n' "$1" "$2"; }
bad()  { FAIL=$((FAIL+1)); [ "$JSON" = "1" ] && echo "{\"item\":\"$1\",\"level\":\"fail\",\"detail\":\"$2\"}" || printf '  \033[31m✗\033[0m %-22s %s\n' "$1" "$2"; }
sec()  { [ "$JSON" = "1" ] || printf '\n\033[1m%s\033[0m\n' "$1"; }

[ "$JSON" = "1" ] || echo "Tesla Sentry F50 部署自检  ($(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'))"

# ---------- 1. 平台 ----------
sec "1. 平台"
if uname -s 2>/dev/null | grep -qi linux; then
    ok "操作系统" "$(uname -s) $(uname -r) $(uname -m)"
else
    bad "操作系统" "$(uname -s) — 必须是 Linux (Windows/macOS 无法做 USB 设备)"
fi

[ "$(id -u)" = "0" ] && ok "权限" "root" || warn "权限" "非 root — 挂载镜像/操作 configfs 会失败, 请用 root 运行"

if [ -r /proc/meminfo ]; then
    MEM=$(awk '/MemTotal/{printf "%d", $2/1024}' /proc/meminfo)
    [ "$MEM" -ge 512 ] && ok "内存" "${MEM}MB" || warn "内存" "${MEM}MB — 建议 ≥512MB, 缩略图/遥测解码会吃紧"
fi
CORES=$(grep -c ^processor /proc/cpuinfo 2>/dev/null || echo ?)
ok "CPU 核心" "$CORES"

# ---------- 2. USB Device (最关键) ----------
sec "2. USB Device / Gadget (硬门槛)"
if [ -d /sys/kernel/config/usb_gadget ]; then
    ok "configfs gadget" "已挂载"
elif [ -d /sys/kernel/config ]; then
    mount -t configfs none /sys/kernel/config 2>/dev/null && ok "configfs gadget" "已手动挂载" || bad "configfs gadget" "未挂载且挂载失败 (CONFIG_CONFIGFS_FS?)"
else
    bad "configfs gadget" "无 configfs — 内核缺少 USB Gadget 支持"
fi

UDC=$(ls /sys/class/udc/ 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -n "$UDC" ]; then
    ok "UDC 控制器" "$UDC (state=$(cat /sys/class/udc/$UDC/state 2>/dev/null))"
else
    bad "UDC 控制器" "没有 /sys/class/udc/* — 该 USB 口只能当主机(Host), 不能当「U盘」被车机识别"
fi

if grep -qw mass_storage /proc/modules 2>/dev/null \
   || ls /sys/module/usb_f_mass_storage >/dev/null 2>&1 \
   || ls /sys/kernel/config/usb_gadget/*/functions/ 2>/dev/null | grep -q mass_storage \
   || ls /sys/kernel/config/usb_gadget/*/configs/*/ 2>/dev/null | grep -q massstorage; then
    ok "mass_storage 功能" "可用"
else
    modprobe usb_f_mass_storage 2>/dev/null && ok "mass_storage 功能" "已加载 (本次)" || \
    if [ -d /sys/kernel/config/usb_gadget ]; then
        warn "mass_storage 功能" "未加载, 可能是内建 (=y) 或缺失; 建 gadget 时才会暴露"
    else
        bad "mass_storage 功能" "缺失"
    fi
fi

if [ -z "$UDC" ]; then
    warn "线缆/端口" "插上数据线后 /sys/class/udc 才有内容; 部分设备需在 DTS/BIOS 里切 peripheral 模式"
fi

# ---------- 3. 文件系统与存储 ----------
sec "3. 文件系统与存储"
if grep -qw exfat /proc/filesystems 2>/dev/null; then
    ok "exFAT (内核)" "支持"
else
    modprobe exfat 2>/dev/null
    grep -qw exfat /proc/filesystems 2>/dev/null && ok "exFAT (内核)" "modprobe 后可用" || \
        bad "exFAT (内核)" "不支持 — 需 CONFIG_EXFAT_FS (Linux 5.7+) 或安装 exfat-linux 驱动"
fi

if [ -e /dev/loop-control ] || [ -b /dev/loop0 ]; then
    ok "loop 设备" "可用"
else
    warn "loop 设备" "未发现 — 归档/U盘管理需要 loop; 可 modprobe loop"
fi

LOSETUP_BIN=""
for c in "$(command -v losetup 2>/dev/null)" /sbin/losetup /usr/sbin/losetup /opt/mu300/busybox-bin/losetup; do
    [ -n "$c" ] && [ -x "$c" ] && { LOSETUP_BIN="$c"; break; }
done
if [ -n "$LOSETUP_BIN" ]; then
    ok "mount/losetup" "$LOSETUP_BIN"
elif command -v mount >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    warn "mount/losetup" "有 mount 但没找到 losetup — 归档与U盘管理需要它 (util-linux 或 busybox) "
else
    bad "mount/losetup" "缺失"
fi

AVAIL=$(df -Pm / 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==2{print $4}')
if [ -n "$AVAIL" ]; then
    [ "$AVAIL" -ge 20480 ] && ok "根分区可用空间" "${AVAIL}MB" || warn "根分区可用空间" "${AVAIL}MB — 镜像与归档建议 ≥20GB"
fi

# ---------- 4. 运行时 ----------
sec "4. 运行时依赖"
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    PYV=$(python3 -c 'import sys;print("%d.%d"%sys.version_info[:2])' 2>/dev/null)
    PYOK=$(python3 -c 'import sys;print(1 if sys.version_info>=(3,7) else 0)' 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$PYOK" = "1" ]; then ok "python3" "$PYV"
    else bad "python3" "$PYV — 需 3.7+ (http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer)"; fi
    python3 -c 'import http.server,json,zipfile,struct,threading' 2>/dev/null && ok "标准库" "齐全 (零第三方依赖)" || bad "标准库" "缺模块, 可能被裁剪过"
else
    bad "python3" "未安装"
fi

if command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ok "ffmpeg" "$(ffmpeg -version 2>/dev/null | head -1 | cut -c1-40)"
elif [ -x /opt/mu300/ffmpeg/ffmpeg ]; then
    ok "ffmpeg" "/opt/mu300/ffmpeg/ffmpeg"
else
    warn "ffmpeg" "未安装 — 列表缩略图缺失, 其它功能正常"
fi

if [ -f /etc/rc.common ] && [ -x /sbin/procd ]; then
    ok "init 系统" "OpenWrt procd (install.sh 直接支持)"
elif [ -d /etc/systemd/system ]; then
    ok "init 系统" "systemd (install.sh 直接支持)"
elif [ -x /sbin/openrc ] || command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    warn "init 系统" "OpenRC — install.sh 走通用 rc.local 分支"
elif [ -x /sbin/init ] && ls -l /sbin/init 2>/dev/null | grep -q busybox; then
    warn "init 系统" "BusyBox init — 走通用 rc.local 分支"
else
    warn "init 系统" "未识别 — 走通用 rc.local 分支, 可手动调 tsf-start.sh"
fi

if [ -d /etc/crontabs ] || [ -f /etc/crontab ] || command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ok "定时任务" "可用 (归档/U盘自愈依赖)"
else
    warn "定时任务" "无 cron — 归档需手动跑 tesla-sync.sh"
fi

# ---------- 5. 结论 ----------
if [ "$JSON" != "1" ]; then
    echo
    if [ "$FAIL" -gt 0 ]; then
        printf '\033[31m结论: 不满足完整部署条件 (%d 项硬门槛未过)\033[0m\n' "$FAIL"
        echo "  → 缺 UDC 时仍可「只跑网页查看器」: 把归档目录放到本机, 用 TSF_ARCHIVE 指向它,"
        echo "    再用别的设备(或有 gadget 能力的小盒子)负责虚拟U盘与归档。"
    elif [ "$WARN" -gt 0 ]; then
        printf '\033[33m结论: 可部署, 但有 %d 项降级/需注意\033[0m\n' "$WARN"
    else
        printf '\033[32m结论: 完全满足, 直接 sudo ./install.sh\033[0m\n'
    fi
    echo
    if [ -z "$UDC" ]; then
        echo "  UDC 为空但你有把握该口支持 Device 模式时: 插上电脑再看一遍本脚本;"
        echo "  个别设备需要在 DTS 里把 usb 控制器设为 peripheral/otg 并启用 dwc2/dwc3。"
    fi
fi
exit 0

#!/bin/sh
# usb-selfheal.sh - 虚拟U盘自愈
#
# 场景: 主机(特斯拉车机 / Windows)对 U 盘执行"弹出"时, mass_storage 会收到
#       SCSI eject, 内核随即清空 lun.0/file, U 盘从此不再出现, 直到重新绑定镜像。
# 本脚本检测到 LUN 为空时自动重新导出, 建议由 cron 每 1~2 分钟执行一次。
#
# 安全: 网页"U盘管理"模式(镜像已挂载)期间不干预, 避免抢 loop/UDC。

set -a
[ ! -f "${TSF_CONF:-/etc/tesla-sentry.conf}" ] || . "${TSF_CONF:-/etc/tesla-sentry.conf}"
set +a

if [ -z "${TSF_USB_LOCK_FD:-}" ]; then
    SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
    VIEWER="${TSF_DIR:-/opt/tesla-sentry}/sentry-viewer.py"
    [ -f "$VIEWER" ] || VIEWER="$SCRIPT_DIR/../sentry-viewer.py"
    exec "${TSF_PYTHON:-python3}" "$VIEWER" --usb-lock-exec /bin/sh "$0" "$@"
fi


: "${TSF_DIR:=/opt/tesla-sentry}"
: "${TSF_IMG:=$TSF_DIR/teslacam.img}"
: "${TSF_MNT:=/tmp/teslamnt}"
: "${TSF_LOG_DIR:=$TSF_DIR}"

IMG="$TSF_IMG"
MNT="$TSF_MNT"
LOG="$TSF_LOG_DIR/tesla-gadget.log"
GADGET_SH="$TSF_DIR/tesla-gadget.sh"

find_gadget() {
    if [ -n "$TSF_GADGET" ] && [ -d "$TSF_GADGET" ]; then echo "$TSF_GADGET"; return 0; fi
    for d in /sys/kernel/config/usb_gadget/*/; do
        [ -d "$d/configs" ] && { echo "${d%/}"; return 0; }
    done
    return 1
}

[ -f "$IMG" ] || exit 0
GADGET=$(find_gadget) || exit 0
LUN="$GADGET/functions/mass_storage.0/lun.0/file"

# 网页正在管理(镜像已挂载) → 不干预
grep -q " $MNT " /proc/mounts && exit 0
# LUN 已绑定 → 无需处理
[ -n "$(cat "$LUN" 2>/dev/null)" ] && exit 0

echo "[$(date +%Y-%m-%d\ %H:%M:%S)] selfheal: LUN empty (host ejected?), re-exporting" >> "$LOG"
sh "$GADGET_SH" on >>"$LOG" 2>&1
